PreToolUse.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCK: Cannot edit environment files — edit these manually' >&2; exit 1;; */package-lock.json|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/yarn.lock) echo 'BLOCK: Cannot edit lock files' >&2; exit 1;; esac

PostToolUse.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac
